title: Machine-learning screen identifies ingenol as a megakaryopoiesis enhancer
summary: A machine learning drug-screening model predicted the natural product ingenol as promoting megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet production. Ingenol promoted megakaryocyte differentiation in K562 and HEL cells and accelerated megakaryopoiesis and thrombopoiesis in radiation-induced thrombocytopenia mice and c-MPL knockout mice, and RNA-seq and blocking experiments implicated PI3K/Akt signaling. The abstract does not describe the model details or quantitative effects.
ai_technology: Machine learning drug-screening model predicting megakaryocyte differentiation activity

evidence.tested: In vitro experiments in two cell lines and in vivo experiments in irradiated and c-MPL knockout mice.
evidence.unknown: Model details and quantitative effect sizes; effects in humans; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine learning screen nominated ingenol as an active compound.
